CREATE TABLE zone_stable_generated(v timestamptz,g timestamptz GENERATED ALWAYS AS(date_trunc('day',v)) STORED)

CREATE TABLE zone_values(id integer, v timestamptz DEFAULT date_trunc('day',timestamptz '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00'), g timestamptz GENERATED ALWAYS AS(date_trunc('day',v,'Asia/Seoul')) STORED); CREATE VIEW zone_view AS SELECT id, extract(epoch FROM date_trunc('day',v)) AS local_day, extract(epoch FROM date_trunc('hour',v,'Asia/Kathmandu')) AS fixed_hour FROM zone_values; INSERT INTO zone_values(id) VALUES(1); PREPARE zone_prepared(text,timestamptz,text) AS SELECT extract(epoch FROM date_trunc($1,$2,$3)) AS value; PREPARE zone_session(timestamptz) AS SELECT extract(epoch FROM date_trunc('day',$1)) AS value

SELECT id,extract(epoch FROM v) AS value,extract(epoch FROM g) AS generated FROM zone_values ORDER BY id; SELECT * FROM zone_view ORDER BY id; EXECUTE zone_prepared('day',timestamptz '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00','Asia/Seoul'); EXECUTE zone_session(timestamptz '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00')
SET TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'; INSERT INTO zone_values(id) VALUES(2); EXECUTE zone_session(timestamptz '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00'); SELECT * FROM zone_view ORDER BY id; SET TIME ZONE 'UTC'
SELECT pg_get_viewdef('zone_view'::regclass) AS definition; SELECT pg_get_expr(adbin,adrelid) AS definition FROM pg_attrdef WHERE adrelid='zone_values'::regclass ORDER BY adnum
